searchText: b"h boruch hashem blessed is he execution plan the awtsmoos renews the river, yet no wave may falsely claim the sea; awtsmoos.com moves from proof to owner to rewrite to proof, until the graph is free. phase one — baseline testimony run the two auto scroll node tests unchanged. run imported style ownership and css quality baselines. confirm the port 8080 listener pid, command, http identity, and canonical route response. trace every import/caller/test for richcommentwarmup and prove whether real dependencies reach it. phase two — cold community proof stop only a process proven to be the awtsmoos application, never tunnel infrastructure. restart through the package defined application entry and capture logs outside product source. measure startup warmup result, first chitas /comment tree, second identical request, and a nonexistent fixture control. if latency is defective, isolate packed store open, manifest readiness, root index read, native tree traversal, imported aggregation, and serialization using external profiling first. rewrite a whole owner only after the measured cause is known; leave no temporary diagnostics behind. phase three — reader behavior witness discover the current chrome target afresh and navigate via real rendered routes. at 390x844 prove document scroll topology and measure countdown cancel, running movement, pause stability, resume movement, stop stability, restart, pace mutation, and clean document end. search production routes for a true inner scroll vessel; accept one only if geometry, overflow, and actual scrolltop movement prove it. phase four — overlay and accessibility sweep enumerate main menu registrations from runtime/source and exercise every child path on phone and desktop. exercise every scribe's lens control, persistence/reset, focus order, internal scrolling, escape/close, safe area, and reduced motion behavior. verify floating controls never overlap or intercept beneath overlays. repair layer ownership, never by arbitrary z index escalation. phase five — css ownership and route inventory build the active post css closure from template links plus recursive imports. map ownership for floating controls, scroll roots, sidebars, sheets, modals, comments, fixed positioning, dimensions, z index, focus/hover/active/disabled, and safe area padding. classify historical owners active / dormant / legacy / dead / compatibility before removal. inventory heichel and social entrypoints, renderers, bootstraps, css roots, apis, overlays, and scroll ownership. phase six — heichel and social browser sweep heichel: 390x844, 430x932, 768x1024, 1440x900; searchText: b"h boruch hashem blessed is he screenshot driven reality the awtsmoos reveals the vessel by what the user actually sees; awtsmoos.com must answer the hand, not the abstraction beneath. observed defects floating auto scroll explicitly requests a three second countdown through autoscrollbutton.js. auto scroll also wires gesture and study surface interruption systems that pause and later resume motion; this creates the reported scroll stop start rhythm. the user wants one contract: start means immediate continuous downward motion; stop means stop. scribe's lens exposes unit switching, four pace presets, pace range, eye line range, estimate/density, font, theme, colors, focus mode, text scale, and reset in one mobile sheet. the visible hierarchy is too option heavy. main menu uses five full width stacked command cards. on a phone this occupies most of the screen for simple navigation. ikar root displays the internal ish ikar heading and generic operational copy such as 3 torah pathways ready. instead of a strong public torah library identity. ikar cards are numbered like a control panel, reinforcing a dashboard feel instead of a living library. remaining work 1. make visible auto scroll immediate and continuous. 2. remove automatic pause/resume from ordinary reader surfaces and gestures. 3. preserve explicit public pause/resume api only for code paths that deliberately request it. 4. reduce lens to primary mobile controls with advanced appearance collapsed. 5. make main menu compact and scannable on phone. 6. give ikar a real bilingual/public identity and remove operational status language/numbering. 7. run syntax, unit, css/ownership, heichel quality, and browser checks. 8. deploy from an isolated release worktree. next action rewrite the exact behavioral and presentation owners, then test the simplified contract.
